Empty exclude_selectors list does not affect output

```swift title="Swift"
import HtmlToMarkdown

let _options = try HtmlToMarkdown.conversionOptionsFromJson("{\"exclude_selectors\":[]}")
let result = try HtmlToMarkdown.convert(html: "<p>Hello world</p>", options: _options)
print(result)
```
